AND_A_RECONCILING_RECORD_IS_STILL_NOT_A_.evidence: Both are titled EXACTLY 'Post-Ablation Pericarditis Reduction Study', both sponsored by St. Vincent Cardiovascular Research Institute, both enrolment 248, both start 2021-05-20, both primary completion 2022-01-30, both COMPLETED, both intervention ['Colchicine'].
AND_A_RECONCILING_RECORD_IS_STILL_NOT_A_.why_this_is_here: This record RECONCILES and the reconciliation is real. It is a check on registration identifiers, and two registration identifiers can name one study -- so 137 distinct registrations is at most 136 distinct studies. The detector cannot see this and does not claim to. It is the same-trial-counted-twice class, one level up, at the registry.

recall_against_the_reviews_own_included_.and_the_limit_of_that_number: Two further trials this review names -- LoDoCo2 and COPS -- are registered on ANZCTR and not on ClinicalTrials.gov. This query CANNOT surface them, so their absence is not a recall failure of the query. It is a limit of the database, and it is why a second search limb is owed.
